errors.text_span: Данните са представени посредством две групи стълбове, всеки от които представлява определен вид грозде.
errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. Each bar represents a single year and is composed of two stacked segments (blue for wine grapes, orange for dessert grapes), not two separate groups of bars.

errors.text_span: достигайки най-висока стойност от около 260 000 тона през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the total value of the stacked bar in 2015 (approx. 260,000 tons) to the wine grapes (blue segment) alone. The value for wine grapes is approximately 245,000 tons.

errors.text_span: и най-ниска през 2021 г. с около 200 000 тона.
errors.evidence: This statement has two errors. First, the lowest production for wine grapes is in 2020 (approx. 145,000 tons), not 2021. Second, the value for wine grapes in 2021 is approximately 165,000 tons, not 200,000 tons.

errors.text_span: като варира в рамките на приблизително 150 000 тона между 2014 и 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This is a massive overestimation for the production of dessert grapes (orange segment). The value for dessert grapes is consistently a small fraction of the total, appearing to be between 5,000 and 15,000 tons each year, not varying within a range of 150,000 tons.
